task: Fix the null pointer panic in the payment processor under high concurrency.

candidate_memories.content: Payment processor panics when charge_id is nil; stack trace points to processor/charge.go:147.
Charge ID must be validated as non-nil before the mutex is acquired in the charge handler.
The charge handler was refactored last sprint; lock acquisition was moved 12 lines earlier.
In concurrent systems, validate shared resource IDs before acquiring any lock to prevent nil-deref panics.
Reviewer flagged that the same nil-check is missing in the refund path; fix both together.
